Bevacizumab Products 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-396211  
Guideline Name 
Bevacizumab Products  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
10/1/2025  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Preferred: Mvasi, Zirabev  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - The drug is being used as indicated by National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN) 
guidelines with a Category of Evidence and Consensus of 1, 2A, or 2B  
 
Product Name:Non-Preferred*: Alymsys, Avastin, Avzivi, Jobevne, Vegzelma, and newly 
launched bevacizumab products  


=== PDF PAGE 238 ===
Page 238 
Approval Length 
Requests for Non-Preferred biosimilars are not approved at this time  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Per your health plan's criteria, the non-preferred drug is not approved for coverage 
because the plan's preferred products are Mvasi and Zirabev. **Please note: The drug(s) 
listed above may require additional review.  
Notes  
*Patients must use preferred bevacizumab biosimilar(s).
